# Vantage

> > Vantage is a multi-cloud cost management and optimization platform for AWS, Azure, GCP, and AI/LLM spend tracking.

Vantage provides FinOps teams and engineers with cost visibility, recommendations, and automation across cloud infrastructure and AI services. The platform supports commitment-based discounts, Kubernetes efficiency, and integrations with tools like Terraform, Jira, and Slack.

## Key Topics

- AWS cost optimization
- Multi-cloud cost management
- FinOps and cost governance
- AI/LLM pricing and spend tracking
- Kubernetes cost efficiency
- Commitment-based discounts (Savings Plans, Reserved Instances)
- Database cost optimization (RDS, Aurora)
- Cost recommendations and automation
- EC2 and compute pricing
- CloudWatch and observability costs
- Terraform infrastructure as code
- Cursor AI coding assistant costs
- Claude and OpenAI model pricing
- EBS storage optimization
- AWS Graviton processors

- [Save 20% on EBS Costs by Migrating from GP2 to GP3](https://www.vantage.sh/blog/ebs-gp2-to-gp3-cost-savings): AWS EBS GP2 to GP3 migration guide for 20% cost savings
